code.title: Day Planner
code.description: A daily planner with accounts, tasks and reminders that arrive as push notifications, even when the tab is closed. I built the React frontend, the API, the database and the deployment.
points: Node.js API with Hono, PostgreSQL with Drizzle, validation with Zod
Login with JWT, password reset by email, log out on all devices
Web Push with a service worker and a cron-triggered job
Works without an account first, then moves your tasks into it
